races.title: State House, District 21
races.note: Unopposed: this seat was decided without a general-election contest, so it won't be on your ballot.

cands.name: Jackie Randall
cands.bio: Democrat. Respiratory therapist and college professor of respiratory therapy; Mayor of Hawthorne 2021 until early 2026, earlier on the Hawthorne City Commission. Won the Aug. 18 Democratic primary with 27.7%; no other candidate qualified, so no vote contest remains.
cands.local_ties: Born and raised in Hawthorne and a lifelong House District 21 resident (her own answers published by Florida Politics).

record.text: Mayor of Hawthorne from 2021 until she stepped down in 2026 to run; earlier served on the Hawthorne City Commission.
Helped establish the first PTA at Hawthorne Middle/High School and organized families to keep local schools open (her own account).

endorsements.text: Ruth's List (abortion-rights advocacy group) plus local officials and faith leaders.
Campaign-announced endorsers include Alachua County Property Appraiser Ayesha Solomon, former Gainesville Mayor Pegeen Hanrahan, several Hawthorne commissioners and local pastors.

cands.gaps: No campaign website, photo or social links found. Campaign finance not researched here. Owner-source check was limited: the alexjoneslive.com site search was run for this name and returned no results. stewpeters.com, rumble.com and infowars.com searches were blocked (HTTP 403) and the shared web-search quota was exhausted, so those were NOT checked.
